ttl.name: Steering Pad Switch Assembly (3-spoke Steering Wheel)

s2.ptxt: Install the steering pad switch RH side with the screw.
Engage the harness of the steering pad switch RH side with each clamp.
Install the steering pad switch LH side with the screw.
Engage the harness of the steering pad switch LH side with each clamp.
Engage the clamp and install the steering pad switch assembly.
Connect the horn connector to the horn button assembly.
Connect the airbag connector to the horn button assembly and lock it securely.
Using a torx socket wrench (T30), install the horn button assembly to the steering wheel assembly with the 2 torx bolts.

s-1.ptxt: Install Steering Wheel Cover Lower NO.3

s2.ptxt: Engage the claws and install steering wheel cover lower NO.3.

s-1.ptxt: Install Steering Wheel Cover Lower NO.2

s2.ptxt: Engage the claws and install steering wheel cover lower NO.2.
Check that the warning light comes on when the IG is turned ON.
Check that the warning light goes off approximately 6 seconds after the IG is turned ON.

item.ptxt: If the warning light remains on even after approximately 6 seconds have elapsed after the IG is turned ON, there is a malfunction in the airbag/pretensioner system.

If the light comes on occasionally even after approximately 6 seconds have elapsed after the IG is turned ON, a short to +B, short to ground or open circuit in the airbag warning light circuit may be the cause.
If the light comes on even with the IG OFF or ACC ON, a malfunction in the power supply system or combination meter assembly may be the cause.
